new_invariants.statement: GLASS DEPTH BAND rule: every surface picks its glass rung by its semantic depth band (BAND 0 bare math substrate / BAND 1 in-flow instrument panel = glass-quiet ambient or glass-resting focused / BAND 2 lifted-anchored chrome = glass-floating; text-plates compose veil-surface), NOT by local taste. No hand-rolled box-shadow/blur/color-mix glass material; the chosen rung owns the material. Documented in INVARIANTS.md so future surfaces inherit the rule.

ONE COLOUR SOURCE: all runtime colour derives from value.js (0.12+) over the canonical icon-rainbow OKLCH ramp — no hand-rolled HSL templating, no duplicated spectrumColor, no bespoke CSS-var parser, no hardcoded Tailwind-palette literals (text-red-400, #60a5fa, #ccc). Accents are contrast-floored by construction (safeAccentColor); per-route identity rides a single --route-accent channel.

ONE MOTION CLOCK / NO RAW rAF: fourier source contains zero requestAnimationFrame call-sites for animation (layout-sync measure loops like the paper teleport are explicitly exempt and doc-marked). All animation flows through the three-layer architecture (CSS-first → glass-ui motion composables → keyframes.js light primitives); value.js owns only colour/easing curves. The epicycle clock is a pure STATE atom; the playhead is a single shared primitive.

PROPORTION + PRM FLOOR: every motion and colour-pop is proportion-governed (audacious-not-gaudy) and honours prefers-reduced-motion at the engine layer (respectReducedMotion), collapsing to a static terminal state — not a shortened one. Every animation is INP-safe (transform/opacity/filter on the compositor; no paint-tier background-position loops; no per-frame getBoundingClientRect on hot input paths).

PLATFORM-OVER-LIBRARY, NO SHIMS (inv-30 hardened): no resurrected dead glass-ui classes (cartoon-card shim DELETED), no phantom variant strings (glass-scrubber), no parallel re-implementations of shipped primitives (CollapsibleSection, local GlassTimeline, hand-rolled focus traps, bespoke popovers). Where fourier hand-rolls a primitive glass-ui should own, fourier BOOKS the ask (inv-16) and consumes once shipped — it never writes glass-ui.

glassui_asks.name: Tonal-accent recipe (accent-tone primitive)
glassui_asks.what: A library recipe minting a contrast-floored three-channel tonal accent (--accent-fill ~12-16%, --accent-edge ~30-40%, --accent-ink solid) from ONE --tone input, as a .accent-tone utility and/or a tone arm on the pill/badge family, reusing value.js mixing + flooring light/dark contrast once.
glassui_asks.why: fourier re-derives this exact color-mix recipe ~57x (NotationPills, EquationModeToggle, BasisSelector, InfoCard, HarmonicLevelGrid). IconChip owns only the icon-GLYPH tone; there is no primitive for the background/border/text tonal FILL every accent chip/active pill/tier badge/legend swatch needs. It IS the colour-pop system the user wants suffused, and generalizes to value.js palette chips + speedtest tone badges.

glassui_asks.name: AtomDiff / diff-highlight viewer
glassui_asks.what: A three-tone (added/removed/changed) keyed row renderer over the canonical J atomdiff shape, reusing the tonal-accent recipe (green/red/amber) + glass-ui's View-Transitions/@starting-style motion floor for row enter/leave.
glassui_asks.why: J-CORE shipped /diff with zero frontend consumer; when M.W8 builds the viewer it would hand-roll the highlighter inside fourier. The three-tone diff row is general — value.js palette diffs + speedtest run-compares want the same grammar. Born in glass-ui, the J consumer stays thin and the diff vocabulary lives in one place.

glassui_asks.name: ConfiguratorLayer header trailing/actions slot
glassui_asks.what: A named trailing (or actions) slot on the ConfiguratorLayer trigger header, right-aligned before the chevron, inside a @click.stop boundary so a slotted reset button does not toggle the section.
glassui_asks.why: fourier needs a header-right panel-wide reset aligned to the title. Today ConfiguratorLayer's only slot is the body, so fourier drops the reset into the body with negative-margin nudges (ContourSettings, BasisSelector) AND maintains an entire parallel CollapsibleSection.vue solely for its actions slot. This slot lets fourier align the reset AND retire CollapsibleSection (inv-30).

glassui_asks.name: DockIconButton active/pressed toggle contract
glassui_asks.what: An active?: boolean toggle prop on DockIconButton (and ideally Button) stamping aria-pressed + data-active and driving a selected visual register (tinting at --dock-selected-accent).
glassui_asks.why: DockIconButton models only press/hover/focus — no selected register. fourier hand-rolls :class="{is-active}" at 7 dock sites but .dock-icon-button.is-active has NO backing paint in either tree — the toggled-on state renders identically to idle. A native pressed prop lets fourier write :active and delete the dead class + per-consumer CSS.

glassui_asks.name: useSpecular composable (pointer-anchored catch-light)
glassui_asks.what: A tiny exported composable wiring a glass surface's --mouse-x/--mouse-y from pointermove (rAF-throttled, reduced-motion-aware) + composing .glass-specular-track, so a consumer gets the iOS-26 illuminate-from-within with one binding.
glassui_asks.why: The material.css specular recipe ships but the ergonomic wiring is not exported; the only way today is hand-writing two custom props on pointermove per surface. fourier wants the catch-light on its focused BAND 1 panels over the bright math canvas; a one-line composable makes it the easy default.

glassui_asks.name: useCharStagger / SplitChars kinetic primitive
glassui_asks.what: A composable/render component that splits a string into per-glyph spans, sets --char-index, and preserves an accessible full-text aria-label — the JS partner to the shipped .char-stagger CSS recipe, PRM-aware terminal state.
glassui_asks.why: glass-ui ships the .char-stagger CSS (needs --char-index) but no helper to produce the spans, so every hero (paper, landing, speedtest) hand-rolls glyph-splitting + a11y labelling. fourier carries a local kill-on-adopt stopgap until this ships.

glassui_asks.name: canvas-anchored-overlay (virtual anchor for top-layer popover)
glassui_asks.what: A way to anchor glass-ui 4.0's top-layer/anchored popover to an arbitrary canvas-relative point (cursor or sampled curve coordinate) via a synthetic getBoundingClientRect rect, rather than only a DOM element.
glassui_asks.why: Both the per-coefficient hover and the convergence-curve hover live over a <canvas>; without a virtual-anchor escape hatch they cannot adopt the 4.0 overlay substrate and must keep bespoke absolutely-positioned divs with manual px math and no keyboard path.

glassui_asks.name: data-scroll-reveal once-discipline for virtualized/teleporting scrollers
glassui_asks.what: An opt-in once mode on [data-scroll-reveal] (a [data-scroll-reveal=once] variant or data-revealed latch) that reveals a child exactly once and renders terminal-state on re-entry.
glassui_asks.why: The view()-timeline recipe re-fires every viewport re-entry — correct for static lists but wrong for fourier's virtual section window (sections unmount/remount) and teleport navigation, causing reveal flicker + corrupting the teleport stable-frame loop. A once-latch lets the paper body adopt scroll-reveal safely.

glassui_asks.name: convergence-reveal motion preset
glassui_asks.what: A reusable 'partial-sum settle' motion preset (spring curve + orchestration helper) driving a 0→1 accumulation clock with PRM-collapse-to-terminal built in — the canonical 'series settling onto target' grammar, composed from useStaggerReveal/useSpring/useCountup.
glassui_asks.why: fourier needs it at every canvas + spectrum entrance and the J.WC spec names it THE signature; the fourier viz + equation routes want the identical accumulation curve, so it belongs in the shared motion layer rather than hand-rolled per-repo.

The in-flight glass-subtle→glass-quiet rename in the dirty tree is SEMANTICALLY WRONG (subtle's 4.0 successor is glass-wash ~0.30α, not quiet ~0.50α — it over-weights every legend/toggle/equation overlay a full rung). It MUST be corrected to glass-wash inside M.W1, not committed standalone, or fourier pins to a half-migrated 4.0 vocab against the still-3.1.0 node_modules.

The K-deploy chronic (months-class babb.dev API outage, host 29 commits behind, silent health-gate rollback since H-era) is cross-repo infra and NOT fully closable inside M — M lands the HEALTHCHECK + the e2e-greening bump, but the deploy-of-record close stays K-owned; risk of M being treated as discharging K when it only carries the fourier-side spine.

Motion CORE (M.W7) is the deepest transposition — collapsing 8 rAF loops + 2 clocks risks regressing the I.γ off-screen-park semantics. Verify RAFPlayback.loop + Sequence.pause retains exact phase on resume; keep the paper teleport measure-loop explicitly EXEMPT (inv-M3 doc-mark) to avoid category-error over-reach.
prose:
Tranche M is an ADOPT-AND-SUFFUSE tranche, not a build-from-scratch one — the re-grounding to a glass-ui 4.0.0 / keyframes 4.2.0 / value.js 0.12.0 world inverts the prior posture: nearly every primitive the last three audits booked as a future glass-ui ASK has SHIPPED, so the work collapses from "wait + hand-roll" to "bump + consume + delete." The single load-bearing move is M.W1, the multi-major bump, which is the hard predecessor of all five mandate axes at once: it greens the J e2e blocker at source (the glass-dock-1 dup-VT-name → useId in 4.x), unblocks the entire motion CORE (the keyframes light tier + glass-ui /motion suite), unblocks the colour leverage (value.js mixColorsN/safeAccentColor), unblocks the typography ladder + the dead-Fraunces activation, and clears the stale RUN-BOARD E1 hinge. It must land as ONE atomic changeset with the BA migration breaks discharged and the in-flight glass-subtle rename CORRECTED to glass-wash — committing that rename standalone, or to glass-quiet, pins fourier to a half-migrated 4.0 vocabulary against a 3.1.0 node_modules.

The gestalt that emerges from merging groups B–E is that fourier's design language is half-built and quarantined, and its motion is fragmented across 8 hand-rolled rAF loops — and BOTH conditions resolve through the same library bump plus a discipline of deletion. The glass story: primary content surfaces are paper stickers (cartoon-card shim), not glass, while the GLASS pillar appears only on transient chrome; the fix is a frozen 3-band depth hierarchy (bare math substrate → in-flow instrument panels → lifted chrome) with the shim DELETED and the catch-light wired over the bright canvas. The colour story: the icon-rainbow IS audacious but lives in one chart legend, while four duplicated HSL spectrumColor copies, a 118-line bespoke parser, and a divergent STATIC.rainbow twin hand-mix what value.js 0.12 generates perceptually from the favicon's own six stops — collapse them to ONE OKLCH ramp and key per-route accents off it. The typography story: .cm-serif silently degrades to Times under 4.0 unless --font-serif-math is bound, Fraunces is vendored-but-dead, and gallery+equation have NO page heading at all — bind the tokens, adopt the φ-ladder, make KaTeX the hero. The motion story: two ping-pong clocks are duplicated verbatim, the manual rAF store is the MEMORY-flagged legacy, and the most on-brand effect (the partial sum visibly converging onto its target) is built at ZERO sites despite the renderers already computing every quantity it needs — collapse to ONE useFourierPlayhead and build the convergence-reveal as THE signature.

Sequencing honours the dependency spine: W1 (bump) is the root; W2 (deploy spine + harness promotion) and W3/W4/W6 (glass/type/colour, all gating only on W1) can parallelize; W5 (control-pane hierarchy) gates on W3's glass ladder; W7 (motion CORE) gates on W1; W8 (J wire-up + scroll heroes) gates on W7's motion architecture and is the J close. Every proposal is no-legacy by construction — each finding DELETES rather than wraps: the cartoon-card shim, the phantom glass-scrubber variant, the four spectrumColor copies, the bespoke colour parser, the eight rAF loops, the hand-rolled focus traps and popovers. The five new invariants (glass-depth-band, one-colour-source, one-motion-clock/no-raw-rAF, proportion+PRM-floor, platform-over-library-no-shims) encode the discipline so the next tranche inherits the rules rather than re-deriving them. The boundary fourier must hold throughout is inv-16: where a primitive belongs IN glass-ui (the tonal-accent recipe, the AtomDiff viewer, the ConfiguratorLayer trailing slot, the DockIconButton active prop, the specular composable, the char-stagger primitive, the canvas-anchored overlay, the once-discipline scroll-reveal, the convergence-reveal preset), fourier BOOKS the ask and consumes once shipped — it never writes glass-ui. M does not subsume J or K: it unblocks J's e2e and wires J's consumer gap, and it carries K's fourier-side deploy spine, but J's data-model close and K's cross-repo API-outage chronic remain owned by their tranches.
